label: Ceasefires Currently in Force
contestNote: AUG 13 status — Gaza: nominally holding since Oct 2025 but 1,257+ deaths/4,131+ injuries from Israeli fire since then; Netanyahu formally rejected the Board of Peace's 15-point roadmap Aug 9, insisting on full Hamas disarmament before any IDF withdrawal, while Hamas reaffirmed conditional acceptance. Lebanon: Jun 26 Washington framework signed; 7th round Rome talks (Aug 4-6) produced a reported verification-country shortlist, but a Lebanese official denied Aug 13 that any such shortlist was agreed; next round early Sep. Iran: Jun 17 Islamabad MOU's 60-day window nears expiry (~Aug 16) with no comprehensive deal; Pakistan made a final diplomatic push Aug 12 but sanctions/frozen-assets remain unresolved. Yemen: 2022 UN truce framework under its worst strain since 2022 — Grundberg warned the UN Security Council Aug 13 that Yemen faces its greatest risk of renewed large-scale war since the 2022 truce. Ethiopia: worst breach yet of 2022 Pretoria agreement, fighting resumed near Sheraro Aug 1, with reports of de-escalation by Aug 2 but no formal reaffirmation of the ceasefire. Colombia: De la Espriella inaugurated Aug 7-8, vows to end 'Total Peace'. DRC-Rwanda: 6th JSCM meeting held in Geneva Aug 12-13, DRC presented FDLR DDR plan. Venezuela: government-opposition talks concluded a first round Aug 12 with judicial-reform and frozen-funds agreements. Ukraine: no ceasefire; POW-exchange channel remains the only functioning track.
